head: Surfshark Dausos protocol now picked automatically on Mac
dek: Surfshark's own Dausos protocol is now the default in its macOS app, and the Auto Protocol setting can choose it when it suits your connection. Surfshark announced it on 16 November.
details: Instead of one shared tunnel for many users, Dausos gives each user a private tunnel, and it encrypts with AEGIS-256X2. Surfshark says it is up to 30% faster than other standard protocols and resistant to future quantum computers; those are the company's own claims. Dausos is only in the Mac app for now; Surfshark says other platforms are coming soon, without a date.
where: Surfshark's macOS app (App Store or Surfshark's site); other platforms later
means: If you use Surfshark on a Mac, the app may now connect with Dausos without you changing anything.
todo: To choose it yourself, open Settings, then VPN Settings, then Protocol, and pick Auto Protocol or Dausos, then connect to a server.
thumb_words: SURFSHARK DAUSOS GOES AUTOMATIC ON MAC
